ROVER-ROVER.title: Rover
ROVER-ROVER.description:
A wanderer from another world who stumbled into the Spire.
Is this a vision of the Somnoire, or a Sonoro Sphere?
Perhaps only by reaching the top of the Spire will you find the answer.
ROVER-ROVER.cardsModifierDescription: Rover's cards will appear in rewards and shops.
ROVER-ROVER.eventDeathPrevention: I will be there for everyone...
ROVER-ROVER.goldMonologue: [sine]So this is the currency of this place?[/sine]
ROVER-ROVER.unlockText: The Rover mod character is ready to play.
